I am pleased with the Company’s solid performance in 2024, which
underscored its resilient business model, enhanced margin profile and
ongoing discipline on expense management.

本人對本公司於2024年的穩健表現甚感欣慰，其突顯了本公司富有韌性
的業務模式、利潤率的提升及對開支的持續嚴格管理。

    Net Income for a reconciliation from the Company’s profit attributable to the equity holders to adjusted net income.
    經調整淨收入為非IFRS財務計量工具，其撇除影響本公司呈報的股權持有人應佔溢利的多項成本、費用及貸項以及若干其他非現金費用（連同其
    各自的稅務影響）的影響，本公司相信其有助證券分析員、投資者及其他利益相關方更全面了解本公司的相關財務表現。有關本公司股權持有人
    應佔溢利與經調整淨收入的對賬，請參閱財務狀況及經營業績的管理層討論與分析 － 經調整淨收入。

    period in 2023 has been adjusted. All other financial statement captions for the year ended December 31, 2023, in this table that have
    not been identified with this footnote were not impacted by this policy change. See note 2(e) Voluntary Change in Accounting Policy to the
    consolidated financial statements for further discussion on this voluntary change in accounting policy.

    動，自2024年第三季度起生效。採納此會計政策變動的影響已追溯應用，並已對2023年的比較期間進行調整。本表中截至2023年12月31日止

      (covenants) specified in a loan arrangement. The IASB confirmed                    排中規定的條件（契約）。IASB確認，僅

      liability’s classification at that date. However, when non-current                 而，當非流動負債受未來契約約束時，

21. Financial Risk Management and Financial                                     21. 財務風險管理及金融工具
    Instruments
      The Company has exposure to the following risks from its use of                  本公司因使用金融工具而面對下列風
      financial instruments:                                                           險：


      •        credit risk;                                                            •      信貸風險；
      •        liquidity risk; and                                                     •      流動資金風險；及
      •        market risk.                                                            •      市場風險。


(a)   Risk Management                                                           (a)    風險管理
      The Company’s Board of Directors is responsible for ensuring that                本公司董事會負責確保本公司制訂及維
      the Company establishes and maintains appropriate and effective                  持適當及有效的風險管理及內部控制系
      risk management and internal control systems. The Board of                       統。董事會已授權審核委員會負責檢討
      Directors has delegated to the Audit Committee the responsibility                本公司的風險管理及內部控制系統。在
      for reviewing the Company’s risk management and internal control                 董事會的監督下，本公司的管理層負責
      systems. The Company’s management, under the oversight of the                    設計、實施及監察本公司的風險管理及
      Board of Directors, is responsible for the design, implementation                內部控制系統。
      and monitoring of the Company’s risk management and internal
      control systems.


(b)   Exposure to Credit Risk                                                   (b)    所承擔的信貸風險
      Credit risk is the risk of financial loss to the Company if a customer           信貸風險為倘金融工具的客戶或交易對
      or counterparty to a financial instrument fails to meet its contractual          手未能履行其合約責任而令本公司承受
      obligations and arises principally from the Company’s receivables                財務虧損的風險，主要來自本公司應收
      from customers. Maximum exposure is limited to the carrying                      客戶的款項。最高的風險水平限於綜合
      amounts of the financial assets presented in the consolidated                    財務報表所呈列金融資產的賬面值。
      financial statements.


      Trade and Other Receivables                                                      應收賬款及其他應收款項

      establish a fair value hierarchy that prioritizes the inputs to valuation          允價值等級架構，該架構排列用以計量

      are as follows:                                                                    量）。公允價值等級架構的三個級別如
